notes: This is the OFF-CHAIN database only. On-chain data (hashes, status, timestamps, roles) lives in the smart contracts and is never duplicated here except as a cached mirror for fast UI reads (see credential_onchain_cache).

tables.name: users
tables.description: All human accounts across roles: citizens, issuer staff, verifier staff, oversight/admin.

columns.name: password_hash
columns.notes: null for citizens who only auth via wallet

columns.name: organization_id
columns.notes: set for ISSUER_ADMIN / VERIFIER_STAFF, null for CITIZEN

columns.name: wallet_address
columns.notes: citizen's MetaMask address, primary identity anchor for CITIZEN role

columns.name: did
columns.notes: decentralized identifier string, derived from wallet_address for prototype (e.g. did:ethr:<address>)

tables.name: organizations
tables.description: Issuer or verifier organizations participating in the consortium (Identity Authority, Education Board, Transport Authority, plus verifier orgs like employers/banks).

columns.name: onchain_address
columns.notes: the wallet address this org uses to sign issuance/verification txs; matches IssuerRegistry.sol entry

columns.name: credential_types_authorized
columns.notes: e.g. ['ACADEMIC'] for Education Authority; informs UI which forms it can issue

tables.name: credential_types
tables.description: Schema catalog describing the shape of each credential type (drives dynamic issuance forms).

columns.name: code
columns.notes: e.g. 'IDENTITY', 'ACADEMIC_DEGREE', 'DRIVING_LICENSE'

columns.name: json_schema
columns.notes: field definitions for the full credential payload, e.g. {institution, degree, graduation_year, gpa}

columns.name: minimal_disclosure_fields
columns.notes: which derived purpose-specific claims can be generated, e.g. {'is_above_18': 'derived from dob'}

tables.name: credentials
tables.description: Full credential payloads, held off-chain. Only the hash of this record's canonical JSON is written on-chain.

columns.name: payload
columns.notes: the actual claim data, shape defined by credential_types.json_schema

columns.name: payload_hash
columns.notes: keccak256 hash of canonicalized payload; MUST match the hash anchored on-chain in CredentialRegistry.sol

columns.name: onchain_anchor_id
columns.notes: tx hash or anchor ID returned from issueAnchor() call

columns.name: status_cache
columns.notes: cached mirror of on-chain status for fast UI reads; always re-verify against chain before trusting for a real decision

tables.name: purpose_specific_credentials
tables.description: Derived minimal-disclosure credentials (e.g. 'is-above-18') signed alongside a full credential.

columns.name: claim_key
columns.notes: e.g. 'is_above_18'

columns.name: claim_value
columns.notes: e.g. true, or {'eligible': true}

tables.name: presentations
tables.description: A single act of a citizen sharing one or more credentials (or purpose-specific claims) with a verifier. Generated as a QR/link.

columns.name: verifier_org_id
columns.notes: null until a verifier actually opens/claims the presentation

columns.name: credential_ids
columns.notes: which credentials/purpose-specific claims are included

columns.name: consent_signature
columns.notes: MetaMask signature from citizen approving this share

columns.name: consent_hash
columns.notes: hash recorded on-chain via ConsentAudit.sol recordConsentHash()

columns.name: share_token
columns.notes: random token embedded in the QR/link URL

columns.name: expires_at
columns.notes: presentation links should be short-lived, e.g. 15 min

tables.name: verification_events
tables.description: Log of each time a verifier checked a presentation. Mirrors recordPresentationReceipt() on-chain.

tables.name: governance_events
tables.description: Cached mirror of Governance.sol events (member proposed/approved/suspended, role updates) for the oversight dashboard.

tables.name: credential_status_events
tables.description: Cached mirror of CredentialStatus.sol events (suspend/reactivate/revoke) for audit history display.

tables.name: documents
tables.description: Uploaded source documents/scans backing a credential (kept off-chain, never hashed into the on-chain anchor directly).

columns.name: file_path
columns.notes: local disk path for prototype; swap for S3/GCS key in production

relationships_summary: organizations 1--* users (staff belong to an org)

on_chain_offchain_reconciliation.principle: Every row that has an onchain_anchor_id / onchain_tx_hash / onchain_receipt_tx field is a CACHE of blockchain truth, written for fast reads. Before showing a verifier a final trust decision, the backend should re-read the live status from CredentialStatus.sol via ethers.js, not rely solely on status_cache.
